facts.condition: Let κ=E[X₁X₂]−E[X₁]E[X₂] for the binary inputs to two channel uses. Any finite two-use Marton candidate that strictly improves on twice the optimal one-use randomized-time-sharing benchmark must satisfy |κ|<√(7 logₑ(2)/248), which is also less than 0.14.

assumptions: The accepted predecessor result supplying the paired-output restriction for an improving two-use Marton candidate applies with the same channel and objective normalization.
Binary inputs are represented by 0 and 1, and logₑ denotes the natural logarithm.
